pages.title: Shipnote — changelogs your users actually read
pages.text:
Changelogs your users actually read.
Shipnote turns merged pull requests into a public changelog and an in-app "What's new" widget.
Small SaaS teams ship every week, but customers never hear about it.
Writing release notes by hand is the chore everyone skips.
Connect GitHub once and Shipnote drafts the notes for you to edit and publish.

pages.title: Pricing — Shipnote
pages.text:
Pricing
Hobby is free for one project.
Team is $19 per month for unlimited projects and a custom domain.
All plans include the in-app widget and email digests.
Cancel anytime.

pages.title: Integrations — Shipnote
pages.text:
Integrations
GitHub and GitLab for pull requests.
Slack and Discord notifications when a release is published.
The widget is a 4 KB script that works with React, Vue and plain HTML.
